# Checklist of the grading criteria

**Repository**

- [x] Public GitHub repository named `IEAP-Series02-RStudio`
- [x] `main` branch up to date (graded branch)
- [x] Clear and complete `README.md`
- [x] `LICENSE` file
- [x] `IEAP-Series02-Rstudio.qmd` file
- [x] Corresponding PDF file, rendered from the final version

**Git history**

- [x] Clear history with meaningful commit messages
- [ ]At least one commit per question of the report (done for parts 2.2
  and 2.3; part 2.1 was committed in a single commit, see *Challenges
  encountered and lessons learned*)
- [ ] Principled use of branches (one branch per member, Pull Requests into
  `main`) (done for parts 2.2, 2.3 and for the fixes and final report;
  part 2.1 was pushed directly to `main`, see *Challenges encountered and
  lessons learned*)

**Content of the notebook**

- [x] Authors and date in the header
- [x] Clickable link to the public GitHub repository
- [x] Analysis of the team's workflow strategy using Git
- [x] Analysis of the challenges encountered and lessons learned
- [x] Complete code and answers to all questions of the "Statistical tests" section (2.1, 2.2, 2.3)
- [x] Data sources with their URLs
- [x] Scientific references with their DOIs

**Submission**

- [ ] PDF uploaded on Moodle
